summary: Security updates from Microsoft install faster and leave no old images behind.

new.title: Security updates install at once
new.text: An update that only moves your installation onto Microsoft's newest images installs at once. It does not wait for running jobs and has no database step.

new.title: Old images are removed
new.text: Once a job has succeeded on the new image, the previous images are removed from your registry.

new.title: Support sees what runs
new.text: Your installation reports which image each job and the web app run, so Invardia support can see that every installation is patched.

fixes.title: The image build reads the version safely
fixes.text: The image build no longer fails when the version file ends with a line break.
